Implementation Plan

Implementation plan for this issue

Clarification mapping
- No Q<ID> clarification questions were asked in the clarify phase.
- `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` indicates there are no unresolved scope/behavior decisions blocking planning.

1. Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/internal-review.yml`
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
- `README.md` only if reusable-workflow input surface is expanded (documentation sync for new optional input)

2. Functions/modules to implement
- `internal-review.yml` caller mapping in `jobs.review.with`:
- Replace unsupported ternary expressions (`? :`) for `pr_is_draft`, `pr_title`, and `pr_body` with GitHub Actions-compatible expressions.
- Keep `workflow_dispatch` behavior (safe defaults) and `pull_request` behavior (real PR metadata).
- `review_autofix.yml` reusable workflow gate in `jobs.review.if`:
- Remove dependence on large raw PR text in expression evaluation where possible.
- Add/consume a compact skip signal (boolean) for `[skip ai]` gating while preserving existing behavior.
- `review_autofix.yml` `workflow_call.inputs`:
- Preserve existing inputs for backward compatibility.
- Add only optional input(s) needed to avoid expression-length failures.

3. Data structures affected
- Reusable workflow input contract for `review_autofix.yml`:
- Existing: `pr_number`, `pr_is_draft`, `pr_title`, `pr_body`, `allow_workflow_edits`.
- Planned addition: optional boolean skip flag (for example `pr_skip_ai`) with default `false`.
- Caller-provided values in `internal-review.yml`:
- `workflow_dispatch`: deterministic defaults (`false` / empty string / skip=false).
- `pull_request`: values derived from PR payload without ternary syntax.

4. API/interface changes
- Backward-compatible only.
- Do not remove or rename current `workflow_call` inputs.
- If a new boolean skip input is added, keep legacy title/body-based path as fallback so existing callers continue to work unchanged.
- No changes to trigger names, job names, labels, secrets, or repo variables.

5. Potential risks and edge cases
- `workflow_dispatch` has no `github.event.pull_request`; expressions must fully short-circuit before accessing PR fields.
- Boolean/string coercion in Actions expressions can alter behavior if defaults are not typed carefully.
- Very large PR body content can trigger parser/expression limits when used directly in job-level `if`.
- Conflict to flag: the reported error location `review_autofix.yml:3117` points to a shell command line (no `${{ }}`), so parser diagnostics are likely misattributed; fix should target expression syntax and body-dependent gating first.
- `[skip ai]` semantics must remain unchanged (title OR body match should skip AI review).

6. Testing considerations
- Validate workflow parsing in CI after edits (GitHub parser is the source of truth).
- Event-path checks:
- `pull_request` non-draft without skip marker runs review job.
- `pull_request` draft skips review job.
- `pull_request` with `[skip ai]` in title or body skips review job.
- `workflow_dispatch` still runs and accepts `pr_number`/`allow_workflow_edits`.
- Regression checks:
- No `Unexpected symbol: '?'` errors.
- No `Exceeded max expression length 21000` errors when called via internal wrapper.
- Reusable workflow remains callable by existing wrappers/callers using current inputs.

Representative pattern chosen for implementation
- Use `.github/workflows/internal-validate.yml` as the wrapper reference pattern for safe `with:` forwarding and defaults, then apply the same style to `internal-review.yml`.
